mechanism_narrative: A negative 3-month change in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is always active (no threshold condition required) because the 3-month change is always computed and available.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods with negative FEDFUNDS change are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.0%, it signals an economic slowdown that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 5.0%), or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an impending monetary tightening cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in periods with rising CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (defined by GDPC1 growth > 2% and HOUST < 900.0), the S&P 500 tends to produce negative returns over the next 20 trading days due to heightened risk of monetary tightening.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 60% of triggered instances (GDPC1 growth > 2% and HOUST < 900.0), or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 850.0, it signals a weakening housing market and economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 60% of triggered instances (HOUST < 850.0), or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A high level of industrial production (INDPRO > 100) is associated with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days. The signal is always active (no threshold condition required) because the INDPRO level is always available.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in INDPRO>100 periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, which is associated with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in periods with rising PAYEMS and falling UNRATE are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a regime defined by high consumer spending (RSAFS > 400000) and low housing starts (HOUST < 900.0), the S&P 500 tends to produce positive returns over the next 60 trading days due to resilient consumer demand.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in < 60% of triggered instances (RSAFS > 400000 and HOUST < 900.0), or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
